extraction_notes: Performance values are approximate readings from Figure 8 because no numerical performance table is provided. Figure 6 contains duplicate Ni-only conversion/selectivity trends and was not repeated. The HNaUSY zeolite curves in Figure 6C were excluded because the paper states these zeolite catalysts were already reported in the literature and are presented for comparison. TOF values in Figure 7 could not be extracted because the corresponding figure image was not supplied in the prompt.
